name: @psyb0t/mailbox
summary: Connect an OpenClaw agent to docker-mailbox over MCP to read, organize, draft, reply and send mail with scoped access.
description: A stdio-to-HTTP bridge for a running docker-mailbox service at /mcp. It exposes mailbox discovery, search, reading, attachments, organization, drafts, replies and sending according to the bearer token's scopes and mailbox allowlist. Run the server yourself, then configure its URL and token. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-mailbox.

MAILBOX_URL.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /mcp).

MAILBOX_TOKEN.description: Bearer token configured on the server (its scopes decide which tools appear).

url.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token matching the server's auth.tokens.
